creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the declared-wait limit (d8e0a77c, 2026-10-21). When a wait runs out after its 10 minutes, the pane reads idle and the maker watch's idle notice fires with its usual text: 'its turn may have ended on an error, or it stopped without saying so'. It could say what happened instead: the wait it declared on <what> ran out after ten minutes with nothing ending it.
title: When a declared wait runs out, the maker's notice still guesses the turn ended on an error
